bwPromptDesktop:
Use the agent-desktop skill to operate this desktop (cicy-desktop client):
- client_id: {{clientId}}

Commands (all take --client {{clientId}}):
  {{c}} tools                # list this desktop's tools
  {{c}} sysinfo              # OS / hardware info
  {{c}} exec '<shell>'       # run a shell command on the desktop
  {{c}} exec-file <script>   # upload & run a local script
  {{c}} rpc <tool> '<json>'  # call any Electron-main tool
